### Day 41: 2 Samuel 2:1–2
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-41-2-samuel-2-12.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 2:1-2
Points:
- David persistently inquired of the Lord until he received clear, specific guidance rather than general direction.
- He was not interested merely in reaching the throne, but in arriving there strictly in God's way.
- Believers must learn patience, asking the Lord for direction before advancing rather than assuming initial impressions are His will.
- Today God guides His people through His written Word, confirming His direction through the Holy Spirit.

### From Fugitive to Monarch
Author: Charles Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-january-12-2024.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 2:1-4
Points:
- After enduring years as a humbled fugitive, David did not aggressively seize power when Saul died.
- People often find success and sudden promotion harder to handle faithfully than suffering.
- Even with the throne open, David waited on God's timing and asked where to begin.
- When opportunities arise, believers should pace their first steps carefully and seek direction in Scripture rather than rushing ahead.
